name: cooling_tower_direct_contact_refsim
title: Direct-contact cooling tower, reference simulation model
summary: Reference simulation model of a direct-contact (evaporative) cooling tower from the ULiège model bank: a counter-flow exchanger between the water and the air leaving the tower saturated, the air side described by a fictitious fluid defined at the wet-bulb temperature (the same theory as the wet cooling coil); the dry heat transfer coefficient, the air-side pressure drop and the fan over-pressure are referred to the nominal conditions and both flow rates and the fan speed act on them.

origin.course: ULiège model bank (Laborelec toolkit lineage), direct contact cooling tower reference simulation model, 4 January 2008; IEA A43 PR2 A16 reference cooling tower model (printed documentation of the same model: 'IEA A43 PR2 A16 Reference cooling tower EES model CASJL PhAJL080108.pdf' in the same folder)

verification.reference: EES stored solution in the source file (64 decoded variable records; 54 variables of the model) and the 'Example of solution' listing printed in the equations window of the source file
verification.notes: 54 common variables, 13 differ above rtol=0.001, maximum relative difference 4.51e-03 (W_su_ct: 0.0100042 against 0.00995912 kg/kg). All 13 differences are the humid-air properties of EES 7.793 against CoolProp (h_a_su_ct 1.78e-03, W_ex_ct 4.31e-03), as in the other humid-air models of the library (CSL-0070 4.4e-03, CSL-0074 4.8e-03); the 41 algebraic results (water and air flow rates, areas, air velocity, pressure drop, NTU, effectiveness, powers, consumption) agree to better than 1e-3 relative, and 23 of them exactly (bit-identical). Ten decoded EES variables are not variables of the model: Q_dot_n_ct, M_dot_a_n_ct_default, M_dot_w_n_ct_default and AU_dry_n_ct_default (the ASHRAE primary toolkit sizing relations, display strings in the source, kept as documentation in the .eescode), a_ct, b_ct, c_ct, d_ct (executable lines of the source that feed no equation, removed as dead code and quoted in the comment block) and m, E (two records that EES does not list among its own 'Variables in Main'). No variable excluded from the comparison.
